Showcase · first built 2026-08-29 · refreshed 2026-10-04 · @rtc/client-react-native vs docs/design/mobile/v1

How far the React Native client sits from the mobile-v1 prototype, screen by screen

Three columns per surface. Before — the committed simctl golden at 89c694adc (2026-08-29), the morning this page was first built and before the fidelity pass touched a single module. App — the golden at 65422a0c7, after the pass and its residuals round. Prototype — the frozen reference shot from the deviation corpus. All three are 1206×2622, the iPhone 17 logical viewport; the app frames are rendered in the real HUD chrome over a static fake ViewModel with motion frozen. The prototype cannot change, so a difference is never a failure — it is a measure of how far the app sat from the design, and how far it moved. Verdicts are an eyeball, not a pixel metric: a pixel diff between two different renderers of different sample data measures nothing.

Module screens

Every module surface the pass worked, in the order it took them (the rank is the original worst-first order, kept so the cards stay addressable). Each card names what moved and what still differs; deliberate additions are called out as such so they are not mistaken for drift.

01

lock/hold

Hold-to-unlock

Close
  • Rebuilt to the design's stack (2026-08-30): accent glow, the 58px hex emblem with its dashed orbit, SESSION LOCKED in Orbitron, an id · desk line, the 112px ring with the ⌖ crosshair, AUTHENTICATING… beneath it while an unlock is in flight.
  • The one addition the design lacks is the password field between the desk line and the ring — the ring here submits real credentials, so the field stays; it wears the tile idiom (1px border, radius 9, tracked mono placeholder). The design's line ends in a clock; the app's ends at the desk.
  • Deliberately unframed on both sides — the design's lock has no chrome either.
02

credit/rfq-tiles

RFQ tiles

Close
  • Rebuilt to the design (2026-08-30): the real desk names, five per card, uppercase; ◂ BEST / ◂ WON after the winning dealer; prices without $, the best in accent; subtitle BUY · 5.0M USD · #101; LIVE / DONE / ALL as outlined pills; every ACCEPT chip-tinted with the best one an accent gradient.
  • Data pass landed (2026-09, #682): the cards now carry the real bond catalogue (AAPL 2.4 08/30) and J.P. MORGAN as the design spells it. What remains is the fixture: one live card and one accepted, where the design's sample shows three live.

Cross-cutting

Differences that appear in every framed pair rather than in one module — and two that look like drift but are not.

Typography
Fixed 2026-08-30: the three remaining face/case misses (Orbitron wordmark, the strip's MODULE value, the connection banner) — and a harness fix behind them: the visual host used to paint first-commit text before the bundled fonts loaded, so every earlier golden showed the system face where the device shows the bundled one. All goldens re-pinned.
Status strip clock
Frozen at 09:47:03 in the app column (a harness pin); the prototype shows a live time. Not drift.
Status bar and dynamic island
Real in the app column (pinned to 09:41, full bars, charged); absent in the prototype, whose bezel draws them outside the captured element. Not drift.

Boot scenes

All eight scene ports against their prototype originals — the real BootSequence in the app columns, pinned at 60% of the ramp; the Before column still shows the pre-pass chrome. The scenes are close; the chrome around them is the deviation, named once below because it is the same in every pair.

  • Scene compositions match one for one — the eight canvases are ports of the eight prototype scenes, and each pair shows the same geometry at a comparable instant.
  • The boot chrome now matches (2026-08-30): the design's bottom block — Orbitron wordmark, one mono line MOBILE OS // SEQ n/8 · SCENE NAME, a 2px single-hue rail, a ▸ boot log line — and SKIP ▸ as the bordered mono pill pinned bottom-right. The 60% readout and the two old subtitle lines are gone.
  • The scene's top telemetry now carries a safe-area inset, so on the device it clears the dynamic island the prototype's bezel never drew.
  • Each app frame is one pinned instant (elapsedSec = 2.52); the prototype shot is whichever instant the corpus captured. Timing differences are not drift.

shell/login

Sign-in (restyled 2026-08-31, #646)

App only

The pre-session sibling of lock/hold, and a surface the design never drew. It wore the pre-redesign form until the residuals round — Title-case sans labels, an ad-hoc hex, a plain text button — and now takes the lock screen's design-derived idiom exactly: the hex emblem, the Orbitron wordmark over a tracked-mono line, bordered mono inputs with uppercase placeholders, AUTHENTICATE ▸ as the boot chrome's bordered pill. New scenario, so it has no before-golden.

How this was made. A Claude Code session composed each app golden beside its prototype shot with ImageMagick, read every pair, and wrote the verdicts and notes by hand; the thumbnails here are 900px WebP (q85) reductions of the committed PNGs — full colour, so gradients stay smooth — inlined at 3× display density so the page is one file. It is a companion, not a source of truth: the generated pair table is docs/design/mobile/v1/reference-shots/DRIFT.md (pnpm prototype-shots:drift), the pending work is the "RN prototype-fidelity pass" entry in docs/STATUS.md, and the finding that the comparison had been measuring the harness rather than the app is T48 in docs/rn-open-items.md. Regenerate with the committed builder (python3 docs/showcase/tools/build_report.py <repo> <commit> <before-goldens-dir>; the before-goldens dir is rebuilt with git show 89c694adc:<golden path> per file) against a newer golden set after each round lands; the Before column is fixed at 89c694adc by construction. The verdicts are the part that has to be re-read, not re-run. Until 2026-08-31 the readout double-counted the eight boot scenes as Moderate after their cards had been re-verdicted Close — a hard-coded tally line, now derived from the cards.
